description: Implement a batch signed URL generation system for storage downloads that replaces temporary API key usage. This will allow read-only users to download files by creating signed URLs for multiple objects in a single management API call, then using those URLs for direct downloads without requiring elevated permissions.
functional_requirements: Create a batch signing endpoint that can generate signed URLs for multiple storage objects in a single request
Replace temporary API key minting with signed URL generation in the storage explorer download functionality
Implement client-side logic to handle batch signed URL requests and subsequent file downloads using those URLs
Ensure the solution works for both single file downloads and folder downloads containing multiple files
Maintain existing download functionality for users with write permissions while enabling downloads for read-only users
